summary: Implemented stdlib-only Chinese-script text statistics tool (count_text API and UTF-8 file/stdin JSON CLI) in examples/text_stats.py, comprehensive unit tests covering empty input, Chinese+English, whitespace/newlines, CRLF, emoji/non-basic Han, invalid input types, and CLI valid/error paths in examples/test_text_stats.py, and concise Chinese usage documentation in examples/TEXT_STATS.md. Verified py_compile and 12/12 unittest passes.
